title: 依 domain responsibility 重整 Production modules
content: 將六個早期操作式 module 實體移至 fault_notices、daily_inspection 與 auto_link packages，保持 class、CLI、MMIS 與 business behavior 不變。
userStory: 建立可持續的 MMIS 功能開發與依賴規範

findings: Six moved modules have identical non-import AST
Package-level public API and all executable commands preserved
No Production import reaches tools or reference code
Architecture, security, test, and code review gates approved
evidence.residual: Raw git diff --check reports two pre-existing trailing-whitespace lines in user-modified Prompt.md; scoped diff check passed. No Live MMIS validation was needed.

comments.name: 專案使用者
comments.text: 核准 move code, do not redesign behavior；要求 domain package 結構並維持所有 external contracts。
